episodes.title: Banishing Evil (Part 1)
episodes.summary: Thirteen years after his death, the "Yiling Patriarch" Wei Wuxian finds himself back among the living once more thanks to Mo Xuanyu, who summoned his spirit into his body to exact revenge on his abusive family.

episodes.title: Banishing Evil (Part 2)
episodes.summary: With Mo Xuanyu's revenge completed, Wei Wuxian flees the village. Before he could venture far, he realizes that his luck is worse than he thought as he encounters not only one, but two important figures of his past. The worst part is the last time he recalled, he did not get along with either of them.

episodes.title: Pursuing Studies
episodes.summary: The story goes back twenty years ago, when life was simpler and Wei Wuxian was but a youngster lazing his way through school. As it turned out, even before he founded demonic cultivation, he and Lan Wangji were already like oil and water.

episodes.title: Water Ghouls
episodes.summary: Thanks to the Wen Sect's manipations, a malicious spirit begins to cause trouble in Caiyi Town, and Wei Wuxian and co. are sent to investigate and deal with the matter.

episodes.title: Heretic Path
episodes.summary: As always, Wei Wuxian and Lan Wangji continue to not get along. If that wasn't enough trouble for them, some corpses escape confinement at a time when both are without their weapons and within the corpses' line of sight.

episodes.title: Returning Home
episodes.summary: After getting into trouble one too many times, Wei Wuxian is sent back home to Lotus Pier where life is almost perfect for him. Almost.

episodes.title: The Champion
episodes.summary: The Qishan Wen Sect calls for a Discussion Conference in the form of an archery tournament, and it becomes blatantly obvious that the event is less of a friendly gathering and more of a display of power.

episodes.title: The Indoctrination
episodes.summary: With the clear intention to divide and conquer, the Wen Sect makes its move and attacks several clans, including the Lan Sect, before conscripting the younger cultivators for "reeducation".

episodes.title: Same Boat
episodes.summary: Everyone finds themselves in a tight spot as inside the cave, there is a malevolent spirit ready to devour anyone who disturbs it, and outside the cave are Wen clansmen waiting to kill anyone who escapes.

episodes.title: Troubles Begin
episodes.summary: Wei Wuxian and Lan Wangji defeat the Tortoise of Carnage, and with some outside help they return back to their homes. However, the trouble doesn't stop there as the rift between the Jiang family continues to grow, and some people from the Wen Sect are not the type to let go of grudges so easily.

episodes.title: Mountain Collapse
episodes.summary: Now that the negotiations for peace have ended on less than amicable terms, the Jiang Sect and the Wen Sect engage in an all-out war. But as the Jiang family is currently divided, so is their strength against the enemy.

episodes.title: The Core
episodes.summary: With their home lost and the Wen Sect hot on their trail, Wei Wuxian and Jiang Cheng go on the run while trying to hold on. But it's in times of duress where surviving is easier said than done.

episodes.title: The Land of Death
episodes.summary: Two events simultaneously play out, both of which will be marked in history. Firstly, the Four Great Sects unite to form the Sunshot Campaign. And second, unbeknownst to everyone at the time, is the founding of demonic cultivation.

episodes.title: Hide From the Sun
episodes.summary: The war between the Four Clans and the Wen Sect begins. The Wen Sect initially has the advantage, although they are eventually worn down by the former's willpower and growing numbers. Then to the surprise (and horror) of both, a third party joins the fray.

episodes.title: Calmly Ready
episodes.summary: Even as they are saved from certain death, Lan Wangji and Jiang Cheng are not certain on whether their rescuer is ultimately a friend or a foe. They get their answer, and it is not what they expected.

episodes.title: Collaboration
episodes.summary: Thirteen years have passed, and the Yiling Patriarch is brought back to life. Despite his intentions to live by unnoticed and away from all those he knows, Wei Wuxian changes his mind when he realizes there's something greater at stake...

episodes.title: Resentment
episodes.summary: The search for the ghoul's other limbs begin, and Wei Wuxian and Lan Wangji start at Mt. Huaicang. Soon enough, they realize that there's more to be found than they initially expected.

episodes.title: Puzzle Net
episodes.summary: Lan Wangji and Wei Wuxian follows up the trail that leads to Qing He. Meanwhile, the evil left hand in Gusu escaped.

episodes.title: Uncle
episodes.summary: When Wei Wuxian finds Jin Ling in peril once more, he attempts to save him from a malicious curse. To do so, he needs to look into the boy's inner demons... as well as his own.

episodes.title: Arrogant
episodes.summary: Wei Wuxian knows all too well that Jiang Cheng despises him now and more than ever. Reflecting upon the past once more, he remembered how even after the avenged the tragedy of Lotus Pier's fall, new problems continued to threaten — and destroy — their friendship.

episodes.title: Quarrel
episodes.summary: Wei Wuxian and Wen Ning are syncing what happened all these years.

episodes.title: Heading For Getting Dark
episodes.summary: While he's slowly being cured of the Curse Mark, Wei Wuxian recalls one last memory: his ultimate fallout with the Four Great Clans. Once he wakes, he and Lan Wangji come to the conclusion that there's more than meets the eye with what transpired in the Nightless City.

episodes.title: The Truth
episodes.summary: Wei Wuxian discovered some truth about what happened to him in No Night City. At the same time, they both knew Qinghe Nie Sect's family secret.
